identity.name: Black Bay Fifty-Eight
identity.one_liner: A 39mm diver named for 1958, the year Tudor's Submariner line reached 200 meters of water resistance, with a flatter profile and shorter lugs than the standard 41mm Black Bay.

narrative.story: Tudor introduced the Black Bay Fifty-Eight at Baselworld 2018, shrinking the standard Black Bay case from 41mm to 39mm and flattening the profile to sit closer to the proportions of Tudor's own 1950s-60s Submariners. It runs the in-house MT5402 movement with a 70-hour power reserve, launched the same year as the Black Bay GMT, and became the reference collectors point to when a comparable Rolex Submariner is priced out of reach.
narrative.collector_notes: Early 2018-2019 production is checked against later runs for small differences in bracelet clasp and bezel-insert finish; none affect function, but some buyers pay a premium for identifiably first-batch examples.
